messages.subject: Heatmap in R and/or ggplot2
parts:
I have a dataframe df with columns x, y, and height. I want to create
a heatmap-like plot that creates a grid of x by y, and then color
codes the grid depending on the value of height.

Is there a ggplot2 object to do this? I'm able to easily do this in
Excel with pivot tables and conditional formatting so I'm including a
link image that is close to the output I want. I want to be able to
customize what colors are used for different values of height.

messages.author: daf017f67eba24e8
messages.subject: Re: Heatmap in R and/or ggplot2
parts:
super easy:
ggplot( df, aes(x=x, y=y, fill=height) ) + geom_tile() + geom_text( aes(label=as.character(height)))

though you'll have to switch x=y and y=x to get your excel output, plus play with scale_fill_manual or something.
